uncited: Early works like [Explicit Radiance Fields](806-explicit-radiance-fields.md) demonstrated that direct optimization of voxel grids could achieve fast convergence for static scenes. [Direct Voxel Grid Optimization](4694-direct-voxel-grid-optimization.md) later popularized the approach by showing that a dense voxel grid combined with a shallow MLP could match the quality of NeRF while training orders of magnitude faster.
